title: Button and drop zone
text: Choose files with the button or drop them on the zone around it.

title: Type and size limits
text: Accepted types, extensions, file size, total size, and file count.

title: Clear rejections
text: Files that break a rule are rejected with a reason and a separate event.

title: Removable list
text: Selected files appear in a list where each one can be removed.

title: Form ready
text: Submits with the form and validates like every other field.
